FX-FOG-001.says: As added: white fog from depth 0 to 10, density 50, opacity 100, Foggy Background on: the near top left lightly fogged, everything past depth 10 white; the clear pixel filled with white fog, the half-covering one half.

FX-FOG-002.says: Density 0: the fog grows evenly from depth 0 to 10.

FX-FOG-004.says: Start 4, End 12, density 0: nothing nearer than 4 fogged, the far corner past 12 all fog.

FX-FOG-005.says: Start and End both 6: a cut, no fog nearer than 6, all fog from 6 on.

FX-FOG-006.says: Opacity 50: half of FX-FOG-002's fog, the clear pixel half fog.

FX-FOG-008.says: Foggy Background off: the clear pixel stays clear and the half-covering one keeps its covering.

FX-FOG-009.says: Fog colour #4060a0, a dull blue, density 0.

FX-FOG-010.says: The ramp as the gradient, contribution 100, density 0: no fog in column 0 (black), the full fog in column 7 (white).

FX-FOG-011.says: The ramp, contribution 50: column 0 half fogged.

FX-FOG-013.says: A gradient layer named that is not in the composition: nothing changes, with D-189's warning.

FX-FOG-014.says: End keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4: the fog draws back.

FX-FOG-015.says: Opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4.

FX-FOG-016.says: Start 10, End 2: the other way round, fog thickest nearest.

FX-FOG-017.says: Infinities and not-a-number in the depth: each read as D-348 reads it; the warning every frame.

FX-FOG-018.says: Blender's layout, the depth in ViewLayer.Depth.Z: FX-FOG-001.

FX-FOG-019.says: A file with no depth: unchanged, the warning every frame.

FX-FOG-020.says: On a PNG drawing: unchanged, the warning.

FX-FOG-021.says: On an adjustment layer above the EXR: no file of its own, unchanged, the warning.

FX-FOG-022.says: The layer moved 2 right and 1 down, the ramp as the gradient: FX-FOG-010 moved, the ramp with it.

FX-FOG-025.says: Fog Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
